nodes.label: Cross-Platform Setup Guide
nodes.description: Installation and build guidance for Rust 2024, Node 20+, Tauri, local inference, and platform-specific native dependencies on macOS, Linux, and Windows.

nodes.label: Hardware-Aware Local Model Selection
nodes.description: Users can pre-pull Gemma 4 tiers matched to available VRAM or unified memory, with smaller edge models supporting constrained or CPU-only hosts.

nodes.label: Platform-Native GUI Dependencies
nodes.description: Tauri builds depend on Xcode tools and WebKit equivalents on macOS/Linux, MSVC and WebView2 on Windows, and an X display or xvfb for headless Linux GUI capture.

edges.description: The guide provides model choices based on host capacity.
The guide enumerates native desktop prerequisites by operating system.
The setup guide directs readers to ADR-005 for local model-selection rationale.
